modern: Consider what men are when they are eating, sleeping, procreating, relieving themselves, and so on. Then what kind of men they are when they are domineering and arrogant, or angry and scolding from their high position. But a short time ago, how many they were slaves to, and for what things; and consider what condition they will be in after a little time.
original: Consider what men are when they are eating, sleeping, generating, easing themselves, and so forth. Then what kind of men they are when they are imperious and arrogant, or angry and scolding from their elevated place. But a short time ago to how many they were slaves and for what things; and after a little time consider in what a condition they will be.

explained.summary: Picture the powerful in their ordinary moments: eating, sleeping, having sex, using the toilet. Then picture them lording it over others or scolding from on high. Not long ago they were slaves to all sorts of people and appetites, and before long they’ll be dead. The exercise takes the shine off anyone who seems grand, and makes arrogance, theirs or your own, hard to take seriously.
explained.today: When a boss, a celebrity or a loud online commentator seems intimidating, remember they also queue for coffee, fall asleep on the sofa and argue about the washing-up. It’s hard to feel small next to someone you can picture in their dressing gown.
